notes: This catalog does not register or implement in-game behavior.
Use each projection viewBox/anchor. Do not assume identical padding for all accessories.
Preserve current B behavior outside wardrobe. Keep each player hat after leaving the zone.
shades-white-beard uses fixed neutral colors: no tint or player-color variants.
pharaoh-nemes alternates fixed gold stripes with player-color cloth stripes in both projections; brow band and cobra stay gold.

paper-bag-mask uses fixed cream paper and black ink. Its mouth and jagged hem face forward (-Y) in overhead view. Roof seams and hem openings show the real avatar without baked-in red.
